ego_sincos.reason: GTego pose is fixed in scene frame, but ego context is transformed into each noisy/generated agent local frame. Non-ego local ego heading = wrap(0 − noisy_agent_heading); pos context also depends on noisy agent position/heading.
ego_sincos.not_a_pure_continuity_only_intervention: Changing input width changes ego MLP capacity and consumes a different initialization RNG sequence, affecting subsequently initialized tensors. One-factor intervention means one config switch, not identical parameter initialization everywhere.

count_embedding.agent_count_definition: All per-scene agent rows including ego; no type labels
count_embedding.lane_count_definition: Cropped native map tokens, not raw Scenario Dreamer lane graph elements
count_embedding.new_information: Explicit categorical count embedding/routing for agent count, and explicit map-token count; additional learned parameters/RNG sequence as well. No agent or lane count prediction objective.

heading_loss.interpretation: Current base loss uses shortest-angle residual with L1, requested time power and weight. heading_x0_loss vector_mse remains fallback metadata and must not be described as active heading objective. heading_mse1 arm explicitly changes component kind to MSE.

non_ego_GT_type_conditioning.TRAIN_expected_target_use: GT labels form the supervised noisy type state and CE target and define TRAIN matching groups in separate mode. This is intended training target/coupling use.
non_ego_GT_type_conditioning.SAMPLE_conditioning: Non-ego type state starts from independent standard Gaussian; each next state uses generated logits softmax; no GTnon-ego type teacher feedback. Ego type is explicitly GTconditioned.
non_ego_GT_type_conditioning.type_count_leak_prevented: Both prepared cached ego_feat and denoiser context use N,0,0 instead of GTclass histogram.

ego_log_interpretation.position_heading_length_width_L1_zero: Imposed GT fields restored before diagnostic computation; not evidence of ego predictor accuracy.
ego_log_interpretation.ego_type_accuracy_one: Imposed fixed ego type counted correct via conditioned mask; not learned accuracy.
ego_log_interpretation.ego_velocity: Not fixed in this experiment; ego speed remains generated and should be assessed separately.
